provenance.credit: NISAR L-band data: NASA/JPL-Caltech & ISRO, distributed by ASF DAAC. Derived layer computed by the Global SAR team.
processing: Read unwrappedPhase, coherenceMagnitude, connectedComponents and ionospherePhaseScreen (frequency A, HH) for the area of interest via HTTPS range requests.
Subtracted the product's ionospheric phase screen (included in GUNW but not applied by NASA).
Masked pixels with coherence < 0.3 or outside valid unwrapping components.
Converted phase to line-of-sight displacement: d = -phi * lambda / (4 pi), lambda = 24.20 cm from centerFrequency.
Referenced to zero at the median of a far-field box (-69.1, 9.8, -68.7, 10.0) (W,S,E,N).
Reprojected bilinearly to Web Mercator (EPSG:3857).
Tropospheric delay, solid-earth tides and residual ionosphere NOT corrected.

Fixed display stretch -25 to 0 dB for both dates (comparable).

provenance.credit: NISAR L-band data: NASA/JPL-Caltech & ISRO, distributed by ASF DAAC. Derived layer computed by the Global SAR team.
processing: Read gamma0 HHHH and HVHV (frequency A) for the area of interest via HTTPS range requests.
5x5 boxcar speckle filter on linear power; converted to dB = 10*log10(gamma0).
Water-like = HH < -14.8 dB: the valley between the water and land peaks of the 17 Jan HH histogram (smoothed, 0.5 dB bins).
New water = water-like on 17 Jan AND HH darkened by more than 3 dB since 5 Jan. Water on both dates = water-like on both.
Scene-wide median HH change was +3.1 dB (land brightening, likely wetter soil and/or BETA calibration), which is why a change criterion is required.
Heuristic classification, not validated in the field: wind-roughened water, radar shadow, smooth tarmac and very dry sand can be misclassified.
